description: This file is an Android activity class for editing notes within the Nextcloud Notes Android client app. It manages creating, viewing, editing, and previewing notes, handling UI setup, fragment transactions, intent processing, and user interactions.

classes.name: EditNoteActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for editing, viewing, and managing notes in the app, handling UI, fragment transactions, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up view binding, checks for account, and sets up UI behavior on creation.

methods.name: setImeInsets
methods.description: Adjusts view padding based on window insets for keyboard and navigation bar.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents, refreshes the note fragment based on intent data.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Clears the keep screen on flag when the activity stops.

methods.name: getNoteId
methods.description: Retrieves note ID from the activity intent.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves account ID, or defaults to current account if not specified.

methods.name: launchNoteFragment
methods.description: Determines whether to load an existing, readonly, or new note fragment based on intent.

methods.name: launchExistingNote
methods.description: Starts a fragment to view or edit an existing note.

methods.name: replaceFragment
methods.description: Replaces current fragment with the note fragment.

methods.name: getPreferenceMode
methods.description: Returns the preferred editing mode for the note, considering user preferences.

methods.name: getNoteFragment
methods.description: Creates and returns the appropriate fragment based on mode and note details.

methods.name: getNewNoteFragment
methods.description: Creates a fragment for a new note based on the current mode.

methods.name: launchNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with optional preset content, category, and favorite label, then launches the corresponding fragment.

methods.name: launchReadonlyNote
methods.description: Loads a note in readonly mode from shared content or intent data.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Saves last note mode to preferences, signals note close, and navigates back or to main screen.

methods.name: onNoteUpdated
methods.description: Updates UI elements with the note's title and category info.

methods.name: changeMode
methods.description: Switches between edit, preview, and direct edit modes.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styling based on color.
